name: RealDynLFV
title: A Large-Parallax Benchmark for Real-World Dynamic Light Field Video
overview: RealDynLFV is a large-parallax benchmark for real-world dynamic light field video, comprising 45 dynamic scene sequences recorded from a 5 × 5 camera array.
availability: The benchmark dataset and accompanying resources are being prepared for release. Availability updates will be provided on this project page.

alignment: Camera recordings are temporally aligned in post-processing using audio signals, rather than hardware synchronization
validated_tasks: Light field video reconstruction and coding are the evaluated tasks in the current benchmark.
potential_tasks: The combination of dynamic scenes and multiple viewpoints also offers a basis for exploring light field video interpolation.

benchmark_intro: The benchmark provides a sequence-level training, validation and test split for light field video reconstruction and coding.
